item.title: ACCA Ends Online Exams Over AI Cheating Concerns
item.description: Citing a surge in AI-powered cheating, global accounting body ACCA will discontinue online exams worldwide starting March 2026.

item.title: Trump sets hard line on Hamas, Iran at Netanyahu meet
item.description: US President Donald Trump warned Hamas to disarm within a “very short period of time,” cautioned Iran against rebuilding military capabilities, and reaffirmed an exceptionally close US–Israel partnership.

item.title: J&K Crime Branch files charge sheet against accused in cheating case, names Bihar man

item.title: Six killed as bus plunges into ravine in Uttarakhand's Almora
item.description: At least six people were killed after a bus carrying around 18 passengers lost control and plunged into a deep ravine on the Bhikiyasain-Vinayak road in Uttarakhand's Almora district on Tuesday morning, officials said.

item.title: Neha Bhasin: Legacy doesn’t have to be biological
item.description: Singer-songwriter Neha Bhasin and music producer Sameer Uddin opened up about their decision to not have children. During their appearance on the latest episode of the YouTube show “Rashami Ke Dil Se Dil Tak”, they revealed to the host Rashami Desai that they never wished to have their own children. item.title: Tragic Accident Claims Life of Woman on Way to Temple
item.description: In a heart-wrenching incident, a couple's journey to the temple on Vaikuntha Ekadashi turned fatal when their motorcycle was struck by an unidentified vehicle early this morning in Tirupati.

item.title: Upcoming TG EAPCET 2026 Notifications Expected Soon
item.description: The notification for the Telangana Engineering, Agriculture, and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test (TG EAPCET) 2026, which facilitates admissions into engineering, agriculture, and pharmacy courses such as BE, B.Tech, and B.Pharmacy for the 2026-27 academic year, will be announced shortly.

item.title: Japan confirms season's 1st bird flu outbreak in greater Tokyo area
item.description: Japan's agriculture ministry said on Tuesday that it has confirmed an outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza at a poultry farm in Saitama Prefecture, marking the country's 12th outbreak this season and the first case in the greater Tokyo area.

item.title: Sambhal: Measurement of graveyard near Jama Masjid to begin shortly, police on high alert
item.description: The measurement of the eight-bigha graveyard located near the Jama Masjid in Uttar Pradesh's Sambhal is set to begin shortly on Tuesday.

item.title: CM directs police to ensure tight security in city
item.description: Siddaramaiah instructs officials to deploy a higher number of women police personnel and to actively utilise the services of the ‘Chennamma’ squads
